description: Type the 409 `source-missing` that createBuild (POST /v1/apps/{project}/builds) gets when its `source_sha256` was never uploaded. The spec documents it on that operation ("The source must already be uploaded (409 `source-missing`)"), and the provider guide says "`source-missing` (upload the source, then start the build)" (https://sproutboat.com/docs/api/build-a-provider#errors-and-retries). It generated as the generic Conflict.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The build names a `source_sha256` that is not uploaded. Upload it with `putSource`, then start the build again.
